resultCaveat: toolUseResult has no tool discriminator in census notation: result-path witnesses are pooled across tools, not proof of a per-tool invocation. Unknown/MCP payloads do not declare arbitrary children.
envelopeNote: sdk-tools.d.ts describes tool payloads, not tool_use ids/names, tool_result message envelopes, wireToolInputs, permissionDecision or attachment wrappers. Those catalog sources are explicitly outside this oracle's scope.
